description: 74D Waterways - Provincial Access/Topographic Map Series is a dataset listed in Alberta open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment and Parks. This series of 1:250 000 scale colour maps covers the provincial extent of Alberta and is comprised of 50 maps that are individually named using the National Topographic System (NTS) map sheet identifier. Coverage: Alberta. The portal files it under the publisher Environment and Parks. Its tags are -ALBERTA, -CANADA, 1-250-000-SCALE-MAPS, ALBERTA-TOWNSHIP-SYSTEM, ATS. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML, XML. The portal shows 2026-09-06 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Alberta. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-alberta-portal.
